hiringTeamMessage:
Dear OTI Hiring Team,

I am applying for Senior Product Manager, Job ID 782366. For 14+ years, I have led public-facing digital products, web systems, and implementation work from problem framing and participatory discovery through scoping, delivery, launch, measurement, and durable handoff.

Across CallNYC, WOW List, NYC Artist Coalition/Fair Rent NYC, KC Town Hall's Tired of Tires service, and client work through Thick Arts, I have translated complex resident, stakeholder, policy, and operational needs into usable services, technical systems, and clear delivery structures. I bring hands-on web engineering fluency, cross-functional leadership, public communications experience, and a disciplined approach to accessibility, privacy, evidence, and collective credit.

I would be excited to help the PIT Crew ship trustworthy, accessible resident-facing products while strengthening lasting product capacity inside OTI. My portfolio at https://jamieburk.art documents the work and methods behind this application.

Thank you for your consideration,
Jamie Burkart
